Please create a realistic 3-year plan for a food content creator named Julie. She currently has 1.2M followers for her quick healthy recipe videos. Over the next three years, she wants to grow her online presence and release a cookbook, but she is torn between traditional publishing and self-publishing.

She only works four days a week and has a limited budget and time. Please include a clear comparison and recommendation for which publishing path makes the most sense for her situation, along with a year-by-year roadmap that fits her schedule and budget without burning her out.
